I'll need input from laboratory quality, waste logistics, and warehouse supervision. Is everyone available to walk through this now?

transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we proceed. My laboratory analysis on these drums found 2.4% chlorinated solvent in the spent coolant. I completed this analysis yesterday, but the result hasn't been attached to the waste authorization yet. We need to factor this into the disposal route decision.
